### Insteel Industries Announces Fourth Quarter 2026 Conference Call


September 22, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/425024259/files/doc_news/Insteel-Industries-Announces-Fourth-Quarter-2026-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


MOUNT AIRY, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Insteel Industries Inc. (NYSE: IIIN) today announced that it will release its financial results for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 6:30 a.m. ET. The Company will host a conference call at 10:00 a.m. ET that day. The call will be webcast live on the Company’s website at[https://investor.insteel.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.insteel.com&esheet=54607891&newsitemid=20260922692993&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.insteel.com&index=1&md5=110aac38ee09b36e00f3fad34fd89778) , where it will also be archived for replay.


**About Insteel**


Insteel is the nation’s largest manufacturer of steel wire reinforcing products for concrete construction applications. Insteel manufactures and markets prestressed concrete strand and welded wire reinforcement, including engineered structural mesh, concrete pipe reinforcement and standard welded wire reinforcement. Insteel’s products are sold primarily to manufacturers of concrete products and concrete contractors for use primarily in nonresidential construction applications. Headquartered in Mount Airy, North Carolina, Insteel operates eleven manufacturing facilities across the United States.


Scot Jafroodi
